subject: Is policyVersion required on a run-session open that takes no issues?

body.question: When a box opens a run session with an empty issueIds list, only to report that it is alive, must it still send policyVersion?
body.proposedReading: No: an open with no issues takes no work, so no policy decided anything and the field may be omitted.
body.reason: Our liveness report runs before the plugin is resolved, so it has no plugin commit to send.
